g.text: 1. Why Direct docker.io & Nested runsc Fail in Outer gVisor
2. Inner gvx systrap: Automatic EBUSY Fallback (PR #71)
3. Runtime Syscall Dispatch via Futex Loop (sysmsg_lib.c)
4. Inner gvx Subsystems Serving Nested docker:dind

text.tspan: iptables-nft -> Could not fetch rule set
overlay2 on outer gofer/9p rootfs -> EINVAL
(vfs fallback copies full rootfs on every RUN step)
(outer runsc already holds the single listener slot)
Step 2: Outer gVisor Sentry returns -EBUSY because
the task filter chain already has a user-notify listener
Step 3: Inner gvx installs a plain SECCOMP_RET_TRAP
BPF filter (no listener FD) and sets
1. Guest dockerd / runc thread executes syscall ->
traps via SIGSYS or binary-patched jmp rel32 (syshandler)
2. Stub thread writes registers to shared struct sysmsg,
sets state = THREAD_STATE_PREPARE, and calls FUTEX_WAKE
4. Inner gvx Sentry thread reads sysmsg, executes
syscall in Go, writes return regs, and calls FUTEX_WAKE
1 regular file on outer gofer; provides native overlayfs
Provides virtual docker0 bridge, veth pairs, and
Serves nested runc mount(proc, sysfs, cgroup2) and
pivot_root without calling outer runsc mount(2)
